mind_map.root_node: Weight and Capacity (Mass, Volume Metrics, Pan Balances & Conversions)

key_nodes: Milligram (mg): Micro unit for medical tablet active ingredients and precious metals (1 g = 1,000 mg)
Gram (g): Unit for light grocery items, butter, spices (1 kg = 1,000 g)
Kilogram (kg): Standard metric unit for vegetables, body weight, luggage
sub_branches.misconception_alert: Confusing milligrams and grams when measuring chemical or medicinal doses.
sub_branches.formula_or_rule: Micro Mass Scale: 1 g = 1,000 mg; 1 kg = 1,000 g.
sub_branches.real_world_application: Weighing pharmaceutical pills and kitchen recipe ingredients.

key_nodes: Quintal: Commercial bulk unit for agricultural grain sacks (1 Quintal = 100 kg)
Tonne (Metric Ton): Macro commercial weight for truck loads (1 Tonne = 1,000 kg = 10 Quintals)
Bulk Conversion: Expressing harvest output in Quintals and Tonnes
sub_branches.misconception_alert: Confusing Quintal (100 kg) with Tonne (1,000 kg).
sub_branches.formula_or_rule: Bulk Mass Scale: 1 Quintal = 100 kg; 1 Tonne = 1,000 kg = 10 Quintals.
sub_branches.real_world_application: Agricultural mandi sales, freight shipping, and factory cargo weight.

key_nodes: Millilitre (ml): Unit for small liquid volumes, medicine spoons, juice pouches (1 Litre = 1,000 ml)
Litre (L): Standard metric unit for milk, water bottles, fuel tanks
Fractional Benchmarks: 1/2 Litre = 500 ml; 1/4 Litre = 250 ml; 3/4 Litre = 750 ml
Measuring Cylinders & Beakers: Calibrated glass containers for volumetric displacement
sub_branches.misconception_alert: Assuming liquid volume changes when poured into a container of different shape.
sub_branches.real_world_application: Dosing liquid medicine, milk packet distribution, and fuel pump dispensing.

sub_branches.sub_title: Double Number Lines for Mass & Capacity
key_nodes: Parallel Axis Alignment: Mapping kg to g or Litres to ml along parallel number lines
Visual Interpolation: Reading fractional parts (e.g., 3/4 kg = 750 g; 1/4 L = 250 ml)
Proportional Problem Solving: Scaling recipe ingredients visually
sub_branches.misconception_alert: Misaligning tick marks for fractional metric benchmarks on double number lines.
sub_branches.formula_or_rule: Proportional Scale: Distance along line corresponds proportionally to metric value.
sub_branches.real_world_application: Commercial baking recipes and beverage factory bottling.

key_nodes: Equilibrium Condition: Left Pan Total Mass = Right Pan Total Mass
Standard Weight Combinations: Balancing 1 kg using combinations of 500 g, 200 g, 100 g weights
Solving Unknown Weights: Unknown Mass = Known Pan Mass - Subtracted Weight
sub_branches.misconception_alert: Neglecting container tare weight when measuring net product mass.
sub_branches.real_world_application: Traditional vegetable market sales and scientific laboratory weighing.

key_nodes: Adding Compound Mass: Sum kg and g separately; regroup 1,000 g as 1 kg
Subtracting Compound Mass: Borrow 1 kg as 1,000 g when g minuend < g subtrahend
Bag Capacity Limits: Calculating total load carried by transport vehicles
sub_branches.misconception_alert: Borrowing 100 g instead of 1,000 g when regrouping kilograms to grams.
sub_branches.formula_or_rule: Mass Regrouping: 1,000 g = 1 kg; 1,000 mg = 1 g.
sub_branches.real_world_application: Managing airline baggage limits and post office parcel pricing.
